basic_profile.bio: I'm a passionate Dungeon Master who has been crafting adventures for over five years. My interests lie heavily in tabletop RPGs, especially Dungeons & Dragons, where I constantly work on creating immersive storylines and balanced encounters. I dislike poorly thought-out game mechanics and railroading in campaigns. Based in Portland, Oregon, I usually engage with the community in the evenings after a long day of work as a software developer. Happily in a long-term relationship, I find joy in teaching newcomers the ropes of RPGs.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in computer science, I have honed analytical skills that help in creating complex game narratives and mechanics. My knowledge in role-playing games comes from years of self-teaching and community involvement, alongside formal education in creative writing.
